description: This file defines structures and classes related to ISO 639 language codes, including the ISO639Entry struct and the Language class, which provides methods for language identification and retrieval of language properties.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Represents a language with methods to find and validate language codes and retrieve language information.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying language data.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the language object has a valid language entry.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns the description of the language or 'Unknown' if invalid.

methods.name: FindLanguage
methods.description: Private method to find a language by its string code.

methods.name: FindLanguage
methods.description: Private method to find a language by its ID.

calls: FindLanguage(const TCHAR* language, const uint32_t length)
